title: tilde ranges with includePrerelease
issue_text:
Tilde range with no patch number misses prereleases under includePrerelease

With `includePrerelease` turned on, a tilde range that leaves out the patch number doesn't match a prerelease of the first version in the range. The docs say `~3.4` means the same as `3.4.x`, and the x-range and caret forms both match it.

```js
const semver = require('semver')
const opts = { includePrerelease: true }
semver.satisfies('3.4.0-beta', '3.4.*', opts)   // true
semver.satisfies('3.4.0-beta', '>=3.4.*', opts) // true
semver.satisfies('3.4.0-beta', '^3.4.*', opts)  // true
semver.satisfies('3.4.0-beta', '~3.4.*', opts)  // false
semver.satisfies('3.4.0-beta', '~3.4', opts)    // false
```

I expected the last two to return `true` as well, so a tilde range behaves like the x-range it is documented to equal.
